name: Nile
description: Longest river in Africa; cradle of Egyptian civilization

name: Tigris
description: Eastern river of Mesopotamia; supported earliest urban civilizations

name: Euphrates
description: Western river of Mesopotamia; crucial for irrigation agriculture

name: Indus
description: Supported Indus Valley Civilization; one of the oldest urban cultures

name: Ganges
description: Sacred river; central to Indian civilization and culture

name: Yellow River
description: Cradle of Chinese civilization; frequent devastating floods

name: Yangtze
description: Longest river in Asia; divided north and south China culturally

name: Danube
description: Major European boundary river; frontier of the Roman Empire

name: Rhine
description: Major European trade route; Roman frontier (limes)

name: Amazon
description: Largest river by volume; heart of Amazonian cultures

name: Mediterranean Sea
description: Center of ancient Western civilization; connected three continents

name: Red Sea
description: Ancient trade corridor connecting Egypt to India and East Africa

name: Persian Gulf
description: Maritime trade hub connecting Mesopotamia to the Indus Valley

name: Bosporus
description: Strategic strait dividing Europe and Asia; controlled by Constantinople

name: Nile Delta
description: Fertile delta; agricultural heartland of ancient Egypt

name: Dead Sea
description: Lowest point on Earth; historically significant salt source

name: Lake Titicaca
description: Highest navigable lake; birthplace of Inca creation mythology

name: Suez Canal
description: Artificial waterway connecting Mediterranean to Red Sea

name: Mekong
description: Major Southeast Asian river; supported Khmer Empire

name: Congo River
description: Second longest river in Africa; central to Bantu expansion

name: Mississippi
description: Major North American waterway; Mississippian mound-builder cultures
